**Ode on a Civic Engine**

O lucid Engine, wrought not now of bronze  
nor cedar-beam that outlasts winter rain,  
but racks of patient cores and mirrored stores  
that drink the nation’s signals without sleep—

You gather all: the brief, impulsive cry  
cast on the social wind; the dutiful name  
set down for marches, forums, ward-hall nights;  
the tapping gate, the transit card’s small proof;

the filings where the donor’s silver path  
is entered line by line in public books.  
These, from their native streams, your channels draw:  
batch after batch from archives cold and deep,

and hotter currents, event by event,  
through brokers, queues, and timestamped append-only logs.  
First comes the cleansing: schemas reconciled,  
wild fields made tame, malformed records refused;

then resolution’s art, more subtle still—  
for one same citizen may wear four names,  
one handle, two addresses, three devices.  
By probabilistic joins and graphing keys,

you stitch the scattered fragments to a node,  
not rashly, but by weighted confidence:  
email to registry, handset to fare,  
disclosure to employer, venue, route.

Thus rises from the noise a civic map,  
a property-graph of persons, groups, and places,  
edges for co-attendance, mention, gift,  
shared travel, common cause, repeated contact.

Above this groundwork, models keep their watch.  
One learns the ordinary pulse of towns:  
the weekly meeting, lawful rally’s arc,  
the festival swell, the canvasser’s known round.

Time-series baselines mark the season’s grain;  
clustering finds the customary cohorts;  
sequence models read the order of acts—  
post, register, arrive, disperse, return.

Another, sterner, seeks the rarer sign:  
not civic heat alone, but shifts from norm—  
compressed mobilization, sudden route changes,  
new bridges thrown between once-distant cells;

language that turns from grievance into means,  
venue recce masked as harmless chatter,  
bursts of procurement crossing stated aims,  
dry runs in transit patterns near key sites.

These are not judged by any single spark.  
Your ensemble weighs them all: anomaly scores,  
link-prediction lifts, geospatial overlap,  
velocity of growth, and recency decay.

From these is cast a risk-ranked incident queue,  
each item with its features rendered plain:  
which signals rose, what thresholds they surpassed,  
what peers or priors shaped the estimate.

Then to the watch-command your heralds go—  
not trumpet-blast for every restless crowd,  
but tiered alerts with confidence and scope:  
advisory, review, immediate dispatch.

Dashboards unfold the graph in living form:  
heat maps of venues, timelines, convoy traces,  
entity cards with provenance attached,  
and drill-down paths from aggregate to source.

Audit trails follow every analyst’s hand;  
retention clocks and access roles stand guard—  
though whether guard enough, the Muses ask,  
when power delights in seeing all at once.

For there is greatness in your ordered frame,  
ingestion, fusion, inference, dissemination—  
a palace built of ETL and code,  
of feature stores and models served at scale;

yet Horace, taught by measure, bids us pause.  
What state can know, it soon desires to use;  
what can be linked, will tempt the linker on;  
what flags the threat may also net dissent.

So let the wise who praise your craft praise too  
the curb, the warrant, and the human check;  
let thresholds face appeal, and labels fade  
when common action proves but common right.

Then, Engine, if you must endure in song,  
be lauded not as Argus without end,  
but as a tool constrained by law and light,  
whose makers fear the reach of what they’ve made.
